headlineOfDay: AI rout sends the Nasdaq down more than 5% as Asian regulators step in to prop up markets, while COP31 collapses without a fossil-fuel deal.

markets.summary: Wall Street suffered a heavy AI-led sell-off in the last session: the Nasdaq fell 5.3% and the S&P 500 3.7%, pushing the index into a correction, with chipmakers such as Nvidia, Micron and Sandisk down 14-16%. Asian markets followed lower and regulators in South Korea, China and Taiwan announced support measures, but US futures and European stocks are pointing to a rebound this morning.
